> 24血影门主（第1页）
萧无恨此时体内真气疯狂逆行，连指尖都难以动弹，艰难地挤出几个字：“杨大哥……我……我动不了了，你快……快离开这里！”
杨凡闻言慢慢踱步过去，蹲下身，脸上的神情温柔得令人发指，他伸出手，轻声道：“小兄弟，别慌，我这就扶你。我们一起走，这永福寺是不能待了。”
那只手离萧无恨的后背越来越近，萧无恨心中一暖，以为杨凡终于要带他突围。
杨凡脸上的温柔瞬间撕裂，取而代之的是狰狞的杀意。他那只看似要搀扶的手，陡然化掌为刀，蕴含着毕生功力的“血影杀心掌”狠狠印在萧无恨的胸口。
萧无恨猝不及防，只觉一股蛮横无匹的掌力瞬间摧垮了本就紊乱的经脉，喉头一甜，一口鲜血狂喷而出，整个人被击飞出去，重重撞在禅房的梁柱上，肋骨断裂声清晰可闻。
“为……为什么？”萧无恨意识模糊，看着那个缓缓走近的人影。
杨凡优雅地整理了一下衣袖，仿佛刚才做了一件微不足道的小事。他从怀中掏出一张诡异的血色面具，戴在脸上，声音变得沙哑而阴冷：“为什么？因为我就是血影门主。这一路，为了杀你，我们布了多少局，死了多少高手，现在才终于将你拿下。”
萧无恨瞳孔地震，看看旁边死去的玄容大师：“你……原来你们是一伙的……”
“哈哈，你现在才知道。”杨凡的眼睛闪烁着嗜血的光，“你知道雾中的那一剑，我差点就杀了你。可惜就差那么一点，你那一剑太厉害了，居然在那种情况下还能伤了我。”
萧无恨看着一步步逼近的杨凡，愤恨说道：“血影门主，我和你究竟多大仇恨，你如此布局要置我于死地？”
杨凡哈哈一笑道：“要杀你的是欧阳长青，你的脑袋可值十万两银子，你说你该不该死！”说完便是一掌劈向萧无恨。
千钧一发之际，萧无恨看着那遮天蔽日的手掌，心中的悲愤冲破极限。这一路的欺骗，在这一刻似乎炸裂。他猛地抬头，七窍流血，却强行提起最后一口精气。拿着剑随手挥出，剑尖颤动，没有光芒，只有一种令人灵魂冻结的死寂。杨凡的掌力在接触到剑意的瞬间土崩瓦解，他惊恐地发现，无论自己如何变招，这一剑都避无可避。
剑光闪过，杨凡的那只手掌连同半个头颅，被齐齐削去。面具破碎，露出那张曾经熟悉却此刻扭曲恐怖的脸。
杨凡倒在地上，抽搐着，喉咙里发出咯咯的怪响：“好……好一剑……”
萧无恨一剑出完，彻底脱力，眼前一黑，昏死在血泊之中。

> 24 Blood Shadow Sect Master (Page 1)
At this time, Xiao Wuhen's internal energy was going crazy and retrograde, and he could hardly move his fingertips. He squeezed out a few words with difficulty: "Brother Yang...I...I can't move, you hurry...get out of here!"
After hearing the words, Yang Fan slowly walked over and squatted down. The expression on his face was so gentle that he stretched out his hand and said softly: "Little brother, don't panic, I will help you right now. Let's go together, we can't stay in Yongfu Temple anymore."
The hand was getting closer and closer to Xiao Wuhen's back. Xiao Wuhen felt warm in his heart, thinking that Yang Fan was finally going to lead him out of the encirclement.
The tenderness on Yang Fan's face was instantly torn apart, replaced by ferocious murderous intent. His hand that seemed to be supporting suddenly turned into a knife, and the "Blood Shadow Killing Heart Palm" containing a lifetime of skills was stamped hard on Xiao Wuhen's chest.
Xiao Wuhen was caught off guard, and he felt an unparalleled palm force instantly destroy the already disordered meridians. His throat felt sweet, and a mouthful of blood spurted out. His whole body was sent flying out, and he hit hard against the beams of the Zen room. The sound of broken ribs could be clearly heard.
"Why...why?" Xiao Wuhen was confused and looked at the figure slowly approaching.
Yang Fan adjusted his sleeves elegantly, as if he had just done a trivial thing. He took out a strange blood-colored mask from his arms and put it on his face. His voice became hoarse and cold: "Why? Because I am the leader of the Blood Shadow Sect. Along the way, in order to kill you, we have set up so many rounds and killed so many masters, and now we finally take you down."
Xiao Wuhen's pupils were shaking, and he looked at the dead Master Xuanrong next to him: "You...it turns out you are in the same group..."
"Haha, you only know now." Yang Fan's eyes flashed with bloodthirsty light, "You know that sword in the fog, I almost killed you. It's a pity that it was just a little bit close. Your sword was so powerful that it could hurt me in that situation."
Xiao Wuhen looked at Yang Fan who was approaching step by step, and said angrily: "Master of the Blood Shadow Sect, how much hatred do you and I have? Are you planning to kill me like this?"
Yang Fan laughed and said: "The person who wants to kill you is Ouyang Changqing. Your head is worth a hundred thousand taels of silver. Do you think you should die?" After saying that, he struck Xiao Wuhen with a palm.
At the critical moment, Xiao Wuhen looked at the palm that covered the sky, and the grief and anger in his heart exceeded the limit. The deception along the way seemed to explode at this moment. He raised his head suddenly, bleeding from all his orifices, but he forced himself to bring up the last breath of energy. He held the sword and swung it casually. The tip of the sword trembled. There was no light, only a soul-freezing silence. Yang Fan's palm power collapsed the moment it came into contact with the sword's intention. He was horrified to find that no matter how he changed his moves, the sword was unavoidable.
The sword light flashed, and Yang Fan's palm and half of his head were cut off. The mask shattered, revealing the once-familiar face that was now twisted and horrifying.
Yang Fan fell to the ground, twitching, and there was a strange gurgling sound in his throat: "What a... what a sword..."
After Xiao Wuhen finished using his sword, he was completely powerless, his vision went black, and he passed out in a pool of blood.
